choices.content: Within 1 standard deviation on either side of the mean
Within 2 standard deviations on either side of the mean
Beyond 10 standard deviations on either side of the mean

question.prompt: According to the commonly used empirical rule, where do approximately 95% of values fall?

solutions.explanation: About 68% fall within 1 standard deviation, and about 95% fall within 2 standard deviations. These are approximations.
solutions.title: Empirical rule
